entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I got nowhere else to go.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What's the deal here?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: This the pity party for the guys who[n]didn't get anything on Valentine's?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, lay off...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Must suck to have no game.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Urrgh...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Pardon me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? Ryuji?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, Yusuke! You're in the same boat,[n]huh?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Which boat?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know! The, uh, the big V-day came and[n]went, and you didn't get any chocolates[n]from the ladies, so...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm not sure what you're getting at,[n]but I did receive some chocolates.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Urrgh...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, come to think of it, you ARE[n]kind of a pretty boy.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So if you got all that chocolate,[n]what're you doing here?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A craving struck. I felt a powerful[n]desire for some of Boss's coffee.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And his curry. And perhaps one of his[n]desserts, if the opportunity presents[n]itself.
Can you afford all that?
I can't spot you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It may take some digging, but if I can[n]find all the money on me, I should[n]be able to cover it...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...How about you just take a seat.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh. It's just like last year.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But... maybe I'm...
What's wrong?
You say something?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nah, just...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I was all set to complain, but... I dunno.[n]Maybe girls don't like me for a reason,[n]like I'm doin' somethin' wrong.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh no... Who are you, and what have[n]you done with Ryuji?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ah, shut up, cat! Just thinkin', that's all.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's better than moping, I suppose.[n]Admirably constructive.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right? So... how about it, Boss?[n]Any tips on the ladies?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: My only tips are in a jar.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: While I'm certainly in no rush to find[n]a relationship... I confess I'm curious[n]to hear Boss's thoughts on love.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Same here.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well, uh... it's pretty complicated...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: In my experience, women can be[n]casual about expressing attraction to[n]guys. Sometimes it can be subtle.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: And popular guys definitely pick up[n]on those cues.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So what, we gotta keep an eye out for[n]these hints?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: The opposite.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: See, women—they like guys who know[n]themselves. You gotta know how to be[n]comfortable with who you are.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: And a guy who's constantly on high[n]alert, trying to chase love? Sounds to[n]me like he's still figuring himself out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, this IS complicated.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Yeah, that's love. Never as simple[n]as it looks.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If it was, it wouldn't be any fun.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa... That's deep.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Quite enlightening... but I suppose that[n]confirms it. Pursuing love for its own[n]sake would be fruitless.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll let my heart guide me. When the[n]time is right, I'm sure I'll know.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yusuke seems pretty confident.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I dunno if it's gonna be that easy[n]for me...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, I'm no Yusuke.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But I can work on figurin' myself out.[n]Once I do, I won't have to look for a[n]girlfriend. She'll come lookin' for me!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell, I'm gonna be swimmin' in [n]ladies, haha!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sure you will, kid.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Not used to getting serious about this[n]stuff. Could use a meal after that...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You guys wanna go eat somewhere?[n]My treat.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Seriously!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I-I couldn't ask for a full meal! All I[n]wanted was some coffee and curry...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And that's different, how?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I need me some fancy restaurant[n]sushi! Or a steak! A5 grade!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Even the cat's all worked up. Here,[n]lemme close the shop and we can[n]head out.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, uh, you can have this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Got it from some lady at a[n]convenience store, hehe.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, she was an employee, but hey.
Thanks.
I'll treasure it.
Am I your Valentine...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: No problem. We're bros! And I got it[n]for free anyway.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, you can just eat it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wha—Hell no!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey! If you two lovebirds are finished,[n]we've got a restaurant to get to.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, crap! Sorry!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, they're gonna leave us behind!
